test_cases.title: Valid login redirects Admin to bookings page

steps.action: Navigate to the Team Allocator login page
steps.expected: Login page is displayed with email and password fields

steps.action: Enter valid Admin credentials and click Login

steps.expected: Admin is redirected to the bookings page

steps.action: Navigate to the Team Allocator login page
Enter invalid credentials and click Login

steps.expected: An error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page

test_cases.title: Viewer cannot create or edit bookings

steps.action: Log in as a Viewer user
steps.expected: Viewer is logged in and sees the calendar

steps.action: Attempt to click on a booking to edit it
steps.expected: No edit or delete actions are available in the booking popup

steps.action: Attempt to create a new booking by clicking on the calendar
steps.expected: No booking creation form is shown — action is blocked

test_cases.title: Overbooking warning shows correct count for overlapping bookings

steps.action: Log in as Admin and create two overlapping bookings for the same employee on the same dates
Observe the calendar for that employee on the overlapping dates
steps.expected: An overbooking warning is displayed showing '+1 overbooking'

steps.action: Add a third overlapping booking for the same employee
steps.expected: The overbooking warning updates to '+2 overbooking'

test_cases.title: Filter by project returns only that project's bookings

steps.action: Log in as Admin and open the calendar view
steps.expected: Calendar shows all employees and bookings

steps.action: Apply the project filter for a specific project
steps.expected: Filter is applied and the calendar updates
Only employees and bookings belonging to the selected project are shown — no other project's data is visible
